FN-T8UP51-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 7
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 7 as introduced could reduce potential receipts to state agencies, higher education
institutions, and local boards of education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
amount of funding that otherwise would have been awarded to any such entity if not for the
prohibition, provided by this bill, of applying for, or accepting, federal or private funding for the
purpose of compelling assent to any divisive concepts or any other purpose prohibited in this
act.
